shortDescription: Silvercorp Metals AMEX:SVM slumped 3.3% in Tuesday's trading after reporting preliminary FQ2 revenue fell 13% Y/Y to $72.1M, as lower production was partially offset by the company's 82% increase in average realized silver prices to $61.83/oz and 32% increase in average realized gold prices to $3,9…

children: slumped 3.3% in Tuesday's trading after reporting preliminary FQ2 revenue
Y/Y to $72.1M, as lower production was partially offset by the company's 82% increase in average realized silver prices to $61.83/oz and 32% increase in average realized gold prices to $3,955/oz.

The miner said the Ying Mining District in China's Henan province produced 900K oz of silver and 1,371 oz of gold in Q2, down 41% and 34% Y/Y, respectively, and silver equivalent production fell 42% to 1M oz, consistent with expectations for a 40%-50% impact.

Production has resumed at Ying and reached a 90% operating rate by the end of the quarter after safety improvements were substantially completed and approved by the Chinese government; ~$13.4M was spent on the work, while the GC Mine remains suspended pending approval of a new mine development design and additional work.
said construction of Ying's No. 3 mill remains on track, while heavy rainfall disrupted construction at the El Domo mine.

title: Silvercorp slides as Q2 revenue fell on lower Ying production following safety-related disruption
